description: Kansans understand the importance of separation of powers, and are frustrated that this President is making decisions that are the job of Congress, while our Congressperson is standing by and letting it happen. In a conversation with Matt Matson on his podcast, Within Reason, Lauren stated it is time for Kansans to come together and vote on our common issues, noting that things are very different now and party politics is not working.
